Cognitopia develops life management applications for people who see the world a little differently. We create cognitively accessible web applications for self-management and executive functioning that helps people with cognitive disabilities be more independent, while helping caregivers provide better support. We use modern web technologies to develop our web-based. WHAT IS IT LIKE WORKING AT COGNITOPIA? We are well connected within the local tech community and the beer scene isn’t too shabby here either. results.text: Skip to content Work How we help Expertise Industries About Insights Let’s talk CAREERS / TWENTY IDEAS Good work matters. So does how we do it. We are interested in people who ask useful questions, care about their craft and make the people around them better. Get to know us LIFE AT TWENTY IDEAS Curiosity has some personality here. We care about the work. We also make room for the people doing it: their questions, their lives and the things that make a team feel like a team. Room to play. Doodle-offs, puzzles and an extensive collection of Slack emojis have all been part of our company story. Small moments matter alongside the bigger projects. Room to question. A thoughtful disagreement can improve a product. We value people who explain their reasoning, listen closely and change their minds when they learn something. Room for life. We care about sustainable work and the people beyond the screen. Working arrangements and benefits belong in a specific role conversation, with clear details. Meet the company behind the work THE WORK BEHIND THE WORK Bring your craft. Stay interested in everyone else’s. A useful product takes more than a good handoff. Strategy, design and engineering shape the same decisions here. We look for people who can explain their thinking, listen to the people using the product and help a teammate see a better way forward. You might be mapping a care workflow, making a learning tool clearer or shaping how developers work with AI. The context changes. The responsibility to understand it stays. See the kinds of problems we work on Ask. Make. Share. Make it better. Strong opinions. Room to change your mind. AI, WITH PEOPLE IN CHARGE Curiosity is welcome. So is a good question.
